title: NIST AI TEVV Program
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
summary: NIST identifies test, evaluation, validation, and verification as a measurement-science program for trustworthy AI.
key_findings: The program connects measurement science to AI risk management.
It exposes tools, evaluations, and standards work.
It does not certify named deployments.
why_it_matters: It clarifies the institutional home for turning assurance principles into repeatable methods.
ftfn_relevance: Advances one named Phase 55Y reader journey.
Separates the current evidence stage from downstream operation or outcome claims.
Creates a specific next-record watch point.
evidence_limits: Program activity is upstream of system authorization and operating evidence.
No universal TEVV method is established.
